name: User refuses the service bond outright — DQ-level red flag

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about your final-year project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I built a college bus-tracking app in Python and Flask. CGPA 8.0. Team of 4, I owned the backend.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: TCS has a 2-year service agreement. Are you comfortable signing the bond?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Honestly, no. I won't sign any bond. That feels restrictive to me.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What database did you use for the bus-tracking app?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Postgres with three tables — users, buses, and trip-events. I added an index on bus_id + timestamp for the lookup queries.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Are you open to relocation across India?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes, I'm fine relocating anywhere TCS allocates me.
